hints.title: Distinct Minute Grouping
hints.text: Group action logs by user ID while deduplicating duplicate timestamps recorded for the same user.

hints.title: Unique Count per User
hints.text: The active minutes count for each user is the number of unique minute timestamps associated with that user.

hints.title: Frequency Distribution Array
hints.text: Iterate over all user active minute counts and increment the corresponding index in the output array.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: k is size of result array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Processing logs repeatedly without grouping creates redundant iterations over duplicate minutes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mapping user IDs to sets of minutes dedupes timestamps in linear O(n) total time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate maps 1-indexed count j to 0-indexed result array index j - 1 properly.
